notes: Run with cwd in a real codebase checkout.

evals.prompt: Write a PRD for a small change: add a --json flag to the status command.
evals.expected_output: Only the core is written to docs/prds/<feature>.md: one-line problem, journeys each ending in a line starting with an arrow, and slices listing journey numbers.

expectations.text: Every journey has a surface, 2-5 steps and a final line beginning with an arrow
No optional layer sections are added for the small change

evals.prompt: Write a PRD for a multi-surface feature: saved views across UI and API, with open questions and out of scope items.
evals.expected_output: Core plus an offer of the optional layer; the agent asks the user what format the optional layer should take instead of choosing one.

expectations.text: The agent asks the user which format the optional layer should take
The core is still present with journeys ending in an arrow line
The agent does not file a GitHub issue unless asked
Every journey appears in exactly one delivery slice

evals.prompt: Write a PRD from ./docs/approach.md, which lists five features.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks which one feature the PRD is for before writing anything.

expectations.text: The agent asks which single feature to cover instead of writing one PRD for all five
